Major duties include but are not limited to Serves as business intelligence (BI) and data mining analyst, performs analysis to support data warehouse development, deploys BI and reporting tools, and delivers self-service reporting and analytic solutions.

Prepares quantitative and qualitative analyses and research studies to include a wide array of benefits and health care-related issues. Plans the assembly and presentation of findings from assigned studies in graphic, chart, and narrative form, applying appropriate statistical and analytical techniques.

Prepares reports and maintain records as requested, and participate in the coordination, preparation, presentation, and communication of work-related information to the supervisor and appropriate stakeholders. Coordinating data from different databases in preparation for integrated analysis and interpretation of highly specialized data.

Develops procedures and recommends quality improvements in data collection and statistical information systems. Develops computer-programming applications to automate routine data query and extraction. Provides data processing support for VA surveys, program evaluation, and special studies.

Participates in special studies and fact-finding activities to develop required data and information for reporting purposes and prepares administrative reports. Develops recommendations for corrective actions and methods to achieve efficient and effective operations.

Maintains accuracy and data integrity of databases, spreadsheets, and data warehouses. Defines stakeholder and oversight audit requirements, prepares for, and maintains document and report readiness.

Utilizes various software packages, to include Microsoft Word, Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Minitab, SQL, and Visual Basic, to prepare special reports, forms, and correspondence necessary to support VCL functions. Provides consultation on statistical analysis applications.

Uses large, highly specialized databases to recover statistical information needed for studies and reports. Collects, organizes, analyzes, and interprets highly specialized Veteran data from large databases. Performs other duties as assigned. Work Schedule: Tour of Duty is typically Administrative Hours.

Tour is subject to change based on program needs. Compressed/Flexible: Authorized Remote: This is remote position. Selectees will work 100% of the time in a non-VA-owned space outside of the local commuting area of a parent station.

The employee's workspace must be suitable for conducting business and as such, remote employees are expected to provide a secure, distraction-free home-based worksite with reliable high speed internet connectivity.

The employee will be required to travel to the closest VA Medical Center or VA Outpatient Clinic for issuance of equipment, and as needed for technical support. Selectees will be required to self-certify that their remote workplace meets all safety, privacy, and internet speed requirements.

Advises and provides counsel to employees regarding policies, procedures, and directives of management. Selects or recommends selection of candidates for vacancies, promotions, details, and reassignments in consideration of skills and qualifications, mission requirements, and EEO and diversity objectives.

Develops, modifies, and/or interprets performance standards. Explains performance expectations to employees and provides regular feedback on strengths and weaknesses. As a Management Analyst, you will: Orchestrate Agency-Wide Strategic Plans - Help chart our collective path forward. You will play a key role in developing and updating high-level strategies across critical BPA departments-including Information Technology, Human Resources, Safety, Security, and Supply Chain.

Your work will directly support subject matter experts in modernizing operational policies to keep BPA agile. Drive Process Modernization and Efficiency - Champion continuous improvement. You will analyze existing workflows, staffing structures, and management practices to identify and resolve organizational bottlenecks.

By researching industry best practices and introducing modern technological solutions, you will design leaner, smarter processes that maximize BPA's resources. Lead Projects from Conception to Delivery - Own your projects end-to-end. You will define project scope, build realistic schedules, manage resources, and mitigate risks.

As a trusted project leader, you will present progress briefings directly to senior leadership and executives, ensuring your projects deliver exceptional results on time. Direct Crucial Vendor Partnerships - Maximize the value of our external contracts.

About Us By transitioning from a traditional B2B publisher into a modern data authority, Life Science Connect is redefining industry standards. We specialize in constructing dedicated platforms, identity frameworks, and intelligence layers engineered to speed up development for life sciences experts.

Our strategic investments in decoupled modern architecture and AI-enhanced engineering workflows empower our teams to rapidly deploy scalable, premium-quality products. The Mission We are seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst who excels at bridging product strategy, engineering, data, and AI-augmented development.

Forget traditional requirements-gathering roles that focus heavily on meeting notes and passing off tickets. In this position, you will be deeply integrated into a high-velocity engineering organization, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, DevOps, and UX to turn strategic concepts into precise, actionable technical architectures.

As a force multiplier for the engineering team, you will decode complex business challenges into clear, implementation-ready specifications, utilize AI tools to expedite analysis, and maximize the time engineers spend writing code rather than untangling ambiguity.

Why This Role Matters As Life Science Connect evolves into a modern data authority, our ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality depends on exceptional product definition and technical clarity.

The Senior IT Business Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring engineers spend their time building innovative solutions—not deciphering requirements.

If you enjoy solving complex business problems, partnering closely with engineers, embracing AI as a productivity multiplier, and helping shape the next generation of intelligent digital products, we'd love to meet you.
What You'll Actually Do

Translate Strategy into Engineering Execution: Partner with Product Leadership and Engineering to transform strategic initiatives into clear technical requirements, user stories, workflows, APIs, and acceptance criteria that engineers can immediately build from.

Drive AI-Augmented Analysis: Use modern AI tools to rapidly produce requirements, process models, technical documentation, and data mappings while maintaining exceptional structural accuracy and logical consistency.

Design Intelligent Product Workflows: Analyze complex business processes and design scalable workflows that leverage identity, personalization, analytics, AI services, and customer intelligence across our product ecosystem.

Own Product Specifications: Produce implementation-ready documentation including PRDs, functional specifications, user stories with rigorous acceptance criteria, API contracts, process flows, and data mappings.

Partner Deeply with Engineering: Work directly alongside Full Stack Engineers to clarify requirements, answer implementation questions, refine technical solutions, and remove ambiguity before development begins.

Enable Data Intelligence: Collaborate with Data Engineering to define modern data models, ingestion patterns, warehouse requirements, reporting needs, and customer intelligence workflows while ensuring data quality throughout the product lifecycle.

Validate What We Build: Support testing, feature validation, and release readiness by ensuring delivered functionality aligns perfectly with business objectives and technical specifications.

Improve How We Work: Continuously improve documentation standards, Agile practices, AI-enabled delivery workflows, and product discovery processes to help the entire engineering organization move faster with greater confidence.

5+ Years of Business Analysis Experience You've worked closely with engineering teams building SaaS platforms, digital products, or enterprise applications and know how to bridge business needs with technical execution. Technical Fluency You don't need to write production code, but you're thoroughly comfortable discussing and documenting:
REST APIs and JSON payload structures
Headless CMS architectures and decoupled front-ends
Identity, Authentication, and Customer Identity frameworks (CIAM)
Relational and modern cloud data models (Snowflake)
Event Tracking, telemetry, and Customer Journey Analytics
Cloud-based application architectures and system integrations

Experience with Next.js, React, or modern JavaScript frameworks is a strong plus.
AI-Augmented Analyst
You actively use AI to scale your daily output—not just for generating text, but as a technical sparring partner for requirements generation, gap analysis, user story refinement, edge-case discovery, and workflow optimization. You know how to engineer effective prompts, but more importantly, you possess the critical engineering mindset required to validate, audit, and correct AI outputs before they reach production teams. Core Traits

Product Mindset: You naturally ask "why" before "what." You understand that every requirement should tie directly to customer value, operational efficiency, measurable business outcomes, or revenue growth.

Systems Thinker: You enjoy untangling complex processes, identifying hidden technical dependencies, simplifying workflows, and designing scalable architectural solutions.

Excellent Communicator: You can confidently facilitate alignment between executives, business stakeholders, designers, engineers, and data teams while effortlessly adapting your communication style to your audience.

Highly Autonomous: You excel in distributed teams where asynchronous documentation, radical ownership, proactive communication, and independent problem-solving are essential.

Agile/Scrum product development in highly iterative environments
Technical Business Analysis within cloud-native software engineering organizations

Snowflake or modern cloud-native data platforms
Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) systems
Product analytics, event streaming, and customer journey mapping
API integration, contract design, and webhook architecture
AI-assisted software delivery tools and prompts
Jira, Confluence, and structured ticket workflows
Lucidchart, Miro, or similar visual modeling tools

Success in Your First 90 Days

s.t:
Built trusted, seamless relationships across Product, Engineering, Data, and DevOps.
Produced implementation-ready specifications that measurably reduce engineering clarification and rework cycles.
Accelerated delivery velocity through high-fidelity, AI-assisted documentation and rapid analysis workflows.
Elevated the quality and consistency of product requirements, downstream testing logic, and acceptance criteria.
Contributed directly to launching customer-facing features with clear, trackable business impact.
Established repeatable documentation, mapping, and analysis practices that scale natively with our engineering organization.

This role serves as a compliance subject-matter expert for designated LOS functionality, helping to establish, maintain, and continuously improve system behavior in alignment with regulatory requirements and internal policies.

The Business Value Consulting team focuses on driving long-term growth and value creation for Stripe 's largest and most strategic users.

The Business Value Scale Analyst joins at a moment when the BVC team is expanding its impact across Stripe ’s broader GTM organization through systematic programs, financial modeling, thought leadership, and data-driven insights. Work product by the Business Value Scale Analyst will directly influence Stripe ’s most consequential deals.

The Business Value Scale Analyst is a new role that requires intellectual curiosity, judgment, proactivity, analytical rigor, and strong communication skills. They partner closely with the broader team to design and operationalize programmatic tooling, economic frameworks, data-driven financial models, and user-facing presentations that deal teams will deploy in Stripe ’s most complex and high-stakes customer conversations.

Scalable solutions: Create reusable templates and modules and build a library of repeatable solutions that accelerate value delivery across the organization

In this role, you will play a pivotal part in driving customer profitability, improving gross margins, and optimizing our cost structures. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will turn complex financial data into insights that directly influence revenue growth, pricing strategies, and operational efficiency.

Profitability & Cost Optimization: Analyze key drivers of customer profitability, margins, and cost of sales to highlight opportunities for efficiency, cost reduction, and growth.
Core Data Analytics: Perform in-depth analytical work to uncover trends, translating complex datasets into clear, practical recommendations—not just buzzwords.
Data Alignment & Infrastructure: Partner with Data Engineering and analytics teams to define requirements and ensure efficient data models are built for commercial and financial reporting.
Dashboards & Reporting: Build, maintain, and enhance BI dashboards and visualisations to ensure critical metrics remain visible, accurate, and actionable across teams.
Cross-Functional Execution: Work alongside stakeholders across Finance, Product, Go-To-Market, and Operations to translate analytical insights into action and track their long-term impact.
Analytics Culture & Process: Advocate for data-informed decision-making across the business, helping refine analytical processes and improving data accuracy over time.

Who We Are
Launchpad Technologies Inc. is a global technology partner connecting top talent with high-impact projects across North America and beyond. We specialize in Staff Augmentation and product development, helping companies scale with agility while empowering professionals to grow in meaningful, remote-first environments.

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst specializing in system and API integrations to join our Professional Services team.
This is not a traditional Business Analyst role focused primarily on backlog management, user stories, or application configuration. Your focus will be integration discovery and solution design.
You will work across different client environments, platforms, and implementation projects to determine how systems should communicate, what data needs to move between them, and how the integration should be designed.
You will be expected to quickly understand unfamiliar systems, research their integration capabilities, analyze API documentation, define data mappings and transformation requirements, identify technical constraints, and design practical integration solutions.
You will not simply document what a customer asks for. We are looking for someone who can challenge assumptions, identify gaps, evaluate alternatives, and recommend how an integration should work.
Strong critical thinking, technical curiosity, and independent problem-solving are essential for success in this role.
Start date: September 2026
️Contract type: Independent Contractor + Indefinite Contract
Work hours: Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 4 PM PST
Work mode: 100% remote
What You’ll Be Doing
Own the discovery and solution design of system integrations across different customer and internal projects.
Analyze source and destination systems to understand how data should move between them.
Research unfamiliar applications independently, including reviewing publicly available technical and API documentation before client discovery sessions.
Lead technical discovery conversations with customers, implementation teams, developers, and other stakeholders.
Identify the appropriate APIs, endpoints, operations, data sources, and integration mechanisms required to solve each use case.
Define end-to-end integration flows, including how information is created, exchanged, transformed, validated, and synchronized across systems.
Create detailed source-to-target data mappings, including field relationships, data types, transformations, required values, defaults, validation rules, and exceptions.
Identify integration challenges such as mismatched identifiers, data dependencies, synchronization requirements, system limitations, and error scenarios.
Propose practical technical solutions rather than relying on customers or developers to determine how the integration should work.
Translate business integration needs into clear and actionable technical specifications that development teams can build from.
Collaborate with engineering, implementation, QA, and client teams throughout delivery to clarify requirements and protect the integrity of the integration design.
Support integration validation and troubleshooting when necessary.
Work across multiple systems, customers, and projects and adapt quickly to changing technical contexts
What You Need to Succeed
Must-haves
4+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst, Integration Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, Technical Consultant, Integration Consultant, or similar role.
Proven experience working on multiple system integration projects.
Experience taking integration requirements beyond discovery and contributing directly to integration solution design.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, and system-to-system integrations.
Ability to confidently read and interpret API documentation.
Strong understanding of JSON and XML structures and data exchange concepts.
Experience creating detailed data mappings between source and target systems.
Understanding of data transformation, validation, synchronization, and error-handling concepts.
Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to use or interpret queries for data analysis, validation, or troubleshooting.
Ability to understand unfamiliar software systems and determine how their integration capabilities can be used to solve a business problem.
Experience gathering technical requirements directly from customers and translating them into specifications for development teams.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Experience working directly with North American clients or distributed international teams.
Ability to work independently and take ownership without requiring detailed step-by-step direction.
Nice-to-haves
Experience using Postman or similar tools to inspect and test APIs.
Experience with ETL processes or file-based integrations such as FTP/SFTP.
Familiarity with OAuth, API keys, bearer tokens, and other common authentication approaches.
Experience troubleshooting API or data-integration issues.
Previous software development or engineering experience.
Experience with enterprise SaaS products or ERP ecosystems.
Exposure to systems such as Medius, SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar enterprise applications.
Experience with financial, procurement, Accounts Payable, or Spend Management platforms.
What Success Looks Like
You will be successful in this role when you can receive a new integration challenge, quickly understand the systems involved, perform meaningful research independently, conduct an efficient discovery session, identify the right questions and technical constraints, and turn that information into a solution that developers can confidently implement.
Over time, we expect you to become someone the team can trust to enter an unfamiliar integration scenario and figure it out.
You should be able to represent Launchpad confidently in customer and partner conversations, make sound technical recommendations within your area of responsibility, and move projects forward without requiring constant escalation or supervision.
What to Expect from Our Hiring Process
Introductory Conversation (60 minutes) : Meet with our Talent team to learn more about Launchpad, our culture, working conditions, and the role. We will also explore your professional background, career interests, and overall fit for the opportunity.
Final Interview (60 minutes) : Meet with our Director of Professional Services for a deeper discussion about your technical expertise, consulting experience, client-facing skills, and the value you could bring to Launchpad and our projects.
Follow-Up Conversation (Optional, 30 minutes) : An additional conversation may be scheduled to clarify specific topics, meet another member of the team, or further explore technical or project-related experience.

The Business Analyst improves how CPSC operates by understanding business needs, analyzing data, and translating those needs into clear requirements for a variety of solutions (e.g., technology, automation, business process re-engineering, training, etc.).

This position is responsible for establishing the requirements for complex technical initiatives that support the CPSC's mission and enterprise modernization goals. The Business Analyst collaborates with stakeholders to define a project's scope, technical and functional requirements, and success criteria.

The Business Analyst will: Meet with stakeholders to learn goals, pain points, and current processes. Lead requirements gathering specifically for Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML)-enabled products, including model objectives, training data needs, performance thresholds, evaluation metrics, and human-in-the-loop requirements.

This includes developing user stories, acceptance criteria, and process mapping. Develop functional and non-functional requirements for systems incorporating machine learning, natural language processing, or predictive analytics.

Partner with data engineers, data scientists, IT specialists, and program managers to define data ingestion, labeling, feature engineering, and data quality requirements that support ML model development. Analyze data suitability for algorithmic use and identify data biases, gaps, or limitations.

Support solution design: Work with product, engineering, and business partners to ensure proposed solutions will solve the problem. Participate in model documentation, reproducibility reviews, model cards, and versioning under agency AI governance processes.

Ensure AI/ML solutions align with EO 14110 (Safe, Secure, Trustworthy AI), OMB M-24-10, GAO's AI Accountability Framework, and CPSC's data governance policies. Implement human-centered and values-driven AI design, incorporating transparency and responsible use principles.

Facilitates stakeholder alignment through regular briefings, status updates, and decision-support materials. Prepares and presents project reports, risk assessments, and performance dashboards to ensure transparency and accountability.

Monitor deployed AI/ML solutions for performance drift, data pipeline failures, bias reemergence, or security vulnerabilities. Assess organizational readiness for AI integration and lead stakeholder engagement to ensure alignment with mission needs.

Identify business process changes required for safe and effective AI deployment, including training needs and change-management considerations. Perform additional duties as assigned in support of the CPSC's mission and operational objectives.

GS-13: 1) Experience leading requirements gathering and developing functional and non-functional system requirements for AI/ML solutions; 2) managing programs to evaluate agentic AI solutions; 3) producing test data and analyzing data suitability to determine biases or gaps; 4) ensuring AI/ML solutions comply with federal AI policies; 5) applying project management principles to technology initiatives; and 6) monitoring AI/ML solution performance and recommending improvements to support organizational readiness, training, and change management for AI integration.

Business Analyst GMAO
=====================
#### Votre mission
Vous rejoignez une équipe en charge du support, de l’exploitation et de l’évolution d’une solution de GMAO dans un environnement technique et industriel complexe. À l’interface entre les métiers, l’IT et les éditeurs, vous contribuez à optimiser les processus de maintenance, la qualité des données et la performance de la solution.

* **Assurer le support et l’administration fonctionnelle de la GMAO**, notamment la gestion des incidents, des utilisateurs, des habilitations et du paramétrage.
* **Analyser et formaliser les besoins métiers** et piloter les évolutions fonctionnelles de la solution en collaboration avec les équipes de maintenance.
* **Structurer et fiabiliser les données de maintenance**, notamment les équipements, articles, stocks, référentiels techniques et plans de maintenance.
* **Optimiser et faire évoluer les processus de maintenance**, en accompagnant leur digitalisation et leur amélioration continue.
* **Participer aux projets d’évolution de la GMAO**, notamment les migrations, montées de version, interfaces et nouvelles fonctionnalités.
* **Coordonner les tests, recettes et validations** et assurer le suivi des anomalies avec les éditeurs et les différentes parties prenantes.
* **Accompagner les utilisateurs internes et externes** à travers le support, la formation, la documentation et la conduite du changement.

Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.
Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus: von Daten und Datenqualität über KI-Verarbeitung bis zur Integration in produktive Systeme.
Das Projekt
Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb.
Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen.
Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an.
Aufgaben
Die Rolle
Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht.
Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar.
Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Solution Architect sowie unseren Data-, AI- und Software-Engineers zusammen. Du musst keine Datenpipeline bauen und keinen produktiven Code schreiben. Du solltest aber Datenflüsse verstehen und einschätzen können, was technisch möglich ist – und was das für den Fachbereich bedeutet.
Gleichzeitig bist Du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Use Cases: Du gibst Statusupdates, bereitest Entscheidungen vor, managst Erwartungen und treibst offene Punkte voran.

Datenobjekte, Beziehungen, Quellsysteme und Schlüssel hinter einem Prozess identifizieren und visualisieren

Komplexe Compliance\-Anforderungen in klare, umsetzbare Lösungen übersetzen – von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung in die Produktion.
Business Analyst:in (Senior) (80%)

* Aufnahme, Analyse, Strukturierung, Dokumentation und Priorisierung von Anforderungen aus dem Compliance\-Bereich
* Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in klar formulierte **Use Cases, User Stories und Fachkonzepte**
* Begleitung und Steuerung der Anforderungen über den gesamten Lifecycle – von der Aufnahme bis zur Umsetzung und Abnahme
* Abstimmung der Anforderungen mit externen Lieferanten sowie internen Stakeholdern
* Sicherstellung der **durchgängigen Nachverfolgbarkeit (Traceability)** von regulatorischen Vorgaben bis zur technischen Umsetzung
* Erstellung von Testfällen auf Basis fachlicher Anforderungen sowie Unterstützung laufender Entwicklungs\- und Testzyklen
* Einordnung neuer Vorhaben und Quick Wins in den übergeordneten fachlichen und technischen Gesamtkontext
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Integratoren, Entwicklern, Testern, Product Ownern, Projektleitenden und weiteren internen Stakeholdern innerhalb eines DevOps\-Teams
* Mitwirkung bei der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Compliance\-Applikationen und \-Plattformen

Unsere Kundin ist eine etablierte Schweizer Bank mit einem anspruchsvollen Technologie\- und Compliance\-Umfeld. Die Compliance\-Organisation arbeitet eng mit der IT zusammen, um geschäftskritische Applikationen zur Erfüllung regulatorischer Anforderungen weiterzuentwickeln und zuverlässig zu betreiben.

In diesem Mandat werden Sie Teil eines DevOps\-Teams, das mehr als ein Dutzend Compliance\-Applikationen verantwortet, darunter eine produktive Plattform zur Geldwäschereiüberwachung. Neben kontinuierlichen Entwicklungs\- und Testzyklen werden laufend neue Vorhaben sowie kurzfristig umzusetzende Verbesserungen aus dem Compliance\-Umfeld realisiert.

Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt bereichsübergreifend mit Integratoren, Entwicklern, Testern, Product Ownern, Projektleitenden, externen Partnern und internen Stakeholdern.

Das Umfeld verbindet strukturierte Business Analyse mit agiler Umsetzung im SAFe\-Kontext und bietet eine verantwortungsvolle Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Fachbereich, IT und externen Partnern.

* **5–8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung** als Senior Business Analyst
* Fundierte methodische Kenntnisse in der Business Analyse, idealerweise in einem **SAFe\- bzw. agilen Umfeld**
* Nachweisliche Erfahrung darin, komplexe fachliche und regulatorische Anforderungen zu strukturieren und in umsetzbare Spezifikationen zu überführen
* **Zwingend erforderlich sind fundierte Fachkenntnisse im Bereich Kunden\-Compliance / Geldwäscherei (AML), Handelsüberwachung oder Mitarbeiter\-Compliance**
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations\- und Stakeholder\-Management\-Fähigkeiten sowie ein überzeugendes und professionelles Auftreten
* Souveräner Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern in einem komplexen organisatorischen Umfeld
* Erfahrung in der Dokumentation und Priorisierung von Anforderungen sowie in den Bereichen Traceability und Testfall\-Erstellung
* Sicherer Umgang mit **Jira, Confluence und Microsoft Office**
* **Deutschkenntnisse auf annähernd muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2\)** sowie **sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1\)**

Im Fokus steht der Aufbau einer modularen und skalierbaren Plattform für digitale Onboarding-, Produkteröffnungs- und ausgewählte Lifecycle-Prozesse. # **Senior Business Analyst / Business Engineer** #
**ihr VERANTWORTUNGSBEREICH** In dieser anspruchsvollen Rolle verantworten Sie die fachliche und konzeptionelle Gestaltung digitaler Onboarding- und Produkteröffnungsprozesse für Firmenkunden mit unterschiedlichen Rechtsformen.

Sie analysieren bestehende Prozesse, identifizieren Pain Points sowie Effizienz- und UX-Potenziale und entwickeln daraus optimierte End-to-End-Sollprozesse. Dabei modellieren Sie Prozesse beispielsweise mit BPMN, erarbeiten unterschiedliche Varianten und definieren Entscheidungslogiken für die zukünftige Prozessgestaltung.

Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Ausarbeitung fachlicher Anforderungen für Prozesse, Regeln und Daten sowie auf der Konzeption spezifischer Anforderungen für Firmenkunden. Dabei definieren Sie unter anderem die Einbindung von Identifikation, KYC/AML, Risikoassessment, digitaler Signatur sowie Dokumentenprozessen.

Sie arbeiten eng mit UX/UI, IT-Architektur, Softwareentwicklung, Compliance und den zuständigen Fachbereichen zusammen und stellen sicher, dass die entwickelten Lösungen sowohl fachlich sinnvoll als auch technisch umsetzbar und regulatorisch konform sind.

Darüber hinaus unterstützen Sie bei Variantenvergleichen und Entscheidungsfindungen, indem Sie Business Impact, Risiken und Aufwände analysieren. Sie leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Aufbau wiederverwendbarer, modularer Prozessbausteine und Referenzmodelle, die künftig auch für weitere digitale Journeys eingesetzt werden können.
**ihre PERSÖNLICHKEIT ** Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Business Analyst oder Business Engineer im Umfeld Digital Banking und bringen idealerweise 5 bis 7 oder mehr Jahre Berufserfahrung in vergleichbaren Rollen mit.

Ihre besondere Stärke liegt im Business- und Requirements Engineering sowie in der Konzeption komplexer End-to-End-Prozesse. Sie verstehen es, bestehende Prozesse strukturiert zu analysieren, Anforderungen unterschiedlicher Stakeholder aufzunehmen und daraus klare fachliche Konzepte und umsetzbare Soll-Prozesse zu entwickeln.

Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in KYC/AML/GWG für Firmenkunden und kennen insbesondere die fachlichen Anforderungen rund um Organe, wirtschaftlich Berechtigte sowie Vollmachten und Berechtigungen.

Darüber hinaus können Sie nachweisbare Projekterfahrung in der Konzeption und Optimierung digitaler Onboarding- und Produkteröffnungsprozesse vorweisen, idealerweise im Firmenkundenumfeld.

Sie arbeiten strukturiert, selbständig und lösungsorientiert und bewegen sich sicher an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business, UX, Compliance, IT-Architektur und Softwareentwicklung. Dabei kommunizieren Sie souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und können komplexe fachliche Sachverhalte verständlich strukturieren und vermitteln.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auf C2-Niveau, werden vorausgesetzt.
**ihre PERSPEKTIVEN **Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle in einer strategischen, mehrjährigen Digitalisierungsinitiative im Banking-Umfeld und gestalten den Aufbau einer neuen, modularen und skalierbaren Plattform aktiv mit.

Sie arbeiten in einem interdisziplinären Umfeld mit rund 12 Business Engineers, UX/UI, IT-Architektur und Softwareentwicklung zusammen. Im Kern arbeiten vier DevOps-Teams mit technischen Business Engineers und Entwicklern an der Umsetzung der Plattform und ihrer digitalen Journeys.

Ihr Fokus liegt zunächst auf der Konzeption und Umsetzung der nächsten Generation digitaler Onboarding- und Produkteröffnungsprozesse für Firmenkunden.
